object: Arthur Koestler's term for a hierarchy of holons — entities that are simultaneously autonomous wholes and dependent parts of larger wholes.  Every holon has a dual tendency: self-assertion (maintaining its own identity and boundaries) and integration (functioning as a component of a larger system).  Neither tendency can be eliminated without destroying the system.
